text:
Type: distressed hand-tufted area rug
Use: defining a seating or bed area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: hand-tufted cotton and wool, low pile
Colors: ivory, dark teal blue
Shape: rectangular, distressed grid of broken lines, denser blue toward one end, clean edges, medium size, flat profile
Feel: fresh, artistic, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, teal or navy accents; modern or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Handtufted Cotton and Wool Area Rug, 4' x 6', Distressed Blue and Ivory
product.description: The distressed look of this cotton-and-wool handtufted rug will add a modern accent to your space, but the bright blue-and-ivory coloring is flexible enough to work with any decor. A semiplush pile will soften and brighten bare areas while bringing warmth and comfort. 4'W x 6'L 80% wool, 20% cotton Handtufted with a distressed pattern The medium 0.3" pile suits any indoor space. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
